notes: Strip c: x 3760-5220 plus ~300 px overlap (picks from x 3460 to 5520). Names: Ehrman Avenue is printed only as 'AVE.' along y~1000; it is the straight continuation of the diagonal printed EHRMAN west of the Baxter corner (x~3000), so named Ehrman (check). Wilson Avenue: 'WILSON' printed once between Rockdale and Northern, 'AVE.' printed north of Forest; the curved street from Baxter and the 40 ft segment Hearne-Albany are taken as the same street. Eden Street (x~4145, Ehrman lots to Forest) prints 'ST.' and 'EDEN' separately; it does not connect on this plate with Eden Avenue (x~3900, 70 ft, south from the Albany lots past Louis, Shields, Bethesda to French), which prints 'AVE' and 'EDEN'. Haven Street printed 'HAVEN' / 'ST.'. Elland Circle: loop printed 'ELLAND' on its north leg and '...CIRCLE' on its south leg (reading uncertain; other letters P, R, C near the loop may be block lettering). Ridgeway Avenue segment at the bottom (y~6585) is unnamed here. Large lettering 'LYND', '& HALL'S 1ST', 'BRUNNER'S SUB', 'AUBURN AND', 'AVONDALE', 'WM. BURNETT'S', 'RENZGEHAUSEN'S', 'PERS. SHIFF...' are subdivision/estate names, not streets. Diagonal 36-inch sewer line west of Larona is not a street. Offset crossings recorded as T pairs: Haven/Dury at Forest (~62 px), Rockdale at Wilson (~70 px), Wilson at Hearne (~56 px), Wilson/Elland at Albany (~60 px). Solid lines inside streets (water pipes) ignored when reading centres.
